title: Paris City Center to La Vallée Village by RER A
steps: 1:Go to Châtelet–Les Halles, Auber, Charles de Gaulle–Étoile, Nation, or another central Paris RER A station.|2:Take RER A towards Marne-la-Vallée Chessy.|3:Get off at Val d’Europe station.|4:Follow signs towards La Vallée Village / Centre Commercial Val d’Europe.|5:Walk approximately 5 minutes to the outlet entrance.

title: Charles de Gaulle Airport to La Vallée Village
steps: 1:From CDG Airport, go to the train station inside the airport.|2:Take a TGV train to Marne-la-Vallée Chessy when available.|3:From Marne-la-Vallée Chessy, continue towards Val d’Europe by train, taxi, or local transfer.|4:Get off near Val d’Europe / La Vallée Village.|5:Walk to the outlet entrance.

title: Orly Airport to La Vallée Village
steps: 1:From Orly Airport, take OrlyVal or another airport connection towards the RER network.|2:Connect to central Paris and transfer to RER A.|3:Take RER A towards Marne-la-Vallée Chessy.|4:Get off at Val d’Europe station.|5:Walk approximately 5 minutes to La Vallée Village.

title: Disneyland Paris to La Vallée Village
steps: 1:Start from Disneyland Paris / Marne-la-Vallée Chessy area.|2:Use a short local transfer, taxi, or train connection to Val d’Europe.|3:If staying nearby, walking may also be possible depending on your hotel location.|4:Follow signs to La Vallée Village.

title: Paris City Center to La Vallée Village by Taxi / Uber
steps: 1:Open a taxi or ride-share app and set the destination as La Vallée Village, Serris.|2:Check the estimated fare before confirming the ride.|3:Travel directly to the outlet entrance.|4:For the return trip, check availability before closing time.

title: Seoul Express Bus Terminal to Yeoju Premium Outlets by Direct Express Bus
steps: 1:Go to Express Bus Terminal Station and follow signs for Seoul Express Bus Terminal.|2:Board the direct Yeoju Premium Outlets express bus at Seoul Express Bus Terminal Platform 29.|3:The official one-way fare is KRW 6,400.|4:Weekday departures from Gangnam: 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 13:00, 14:00, 15:00, 17:00, 19:00.|5:Weekday departures from Yeoju: 11:00, 12:00, 13:00, 15:00, 16:00, 17:00, 19:00, 21:00.|6:Weekend and public-holiday departures from Gangnam: 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 12:00, 13:00, 14:00, 15:00, 17:00, 18:00, 19:00.|7:Weekend and public-holiday departures from Yeoju: 11:00, 12:00, 13:00, 14:00, 15:00, 16:00, 17:00, 19:00, 20:00, 21:00.|8:Ride the express bus for approximately 1 hour 10 minutes to Yeoju Premium Outlets.|9:Confirm the current timetable on the official Yeoju Premium Outlets directions page before travel: https://app.premiumoutlets.co.kr/rpage/en/map/index/01

title: Myeongdong Station to Yeoju Premium Outlets by Subway and Bus
steps: 1:Start at Myeongdong Station.|2:Reach Gangnam Station either by Bus 471 from Exit 3 (approximately 30 minutes), or take Line 4 to Sadang Station (approximately 25 minutes) and transfer to Line 2 for Gangnam Station (approximately 14 minutes).|3:Take the Shinbundang Line from Gangnam Station to Pangyo Station (approximately 20 minutes).|4:Transfer to the Gyeonggang Line and travel to Yeoju Station (approximately 60 minutes).|5:Leave Yeoju Station through Exit 4.|6:Take Bus 912, 912-2, or 912-5 to Yeoju Premium Outlets (approximately 15 minutes).|7:Allow approximately 2 hours 30 minutes for the complete journey.|8:Confirm the current route on the official Yeoju Premium Outlets directions page before travel: https://app.premiumoutlets.co.kr/rpage/en/map/index/01

title: Hongik University Station to Yeoju Premium Outlets by Subway and Bus
steps: 1:Start at Hongik University Station.|2:Take Line 2 to Wangsimni Station (approximately 20 minutes).|3:Transfer to the Suin-Bundang Line and travel to Imae Station (approximately 40 minutes).|4:Transfer to the Gyeonggang Line and travel to Yeoju Station (approximately 45 minutes).|5:Leave Yeoju Station through Exit 4.|6:Take Bus 912, 912-2, or 912-5 to Yeoju Premium Outlets (approximately 15 minutes).|7:Allow approximately 2 hours 30 minutes for the complete journey.|8:Confirm the current route on the official Yeoju Premium Outlets directions page before travel: https://app.premiumoutlets.co.kr/rpage/en/map/index/01
